matched_harvest.description: Pool all classified topics (need + random), sort by view_count descending, split at median view_count, compare need fraction between high and low engagement halves, compute Cliff's delta and Mann-Whitney U test
steps: Fetch all topics from forum categories
Classify each topic as need-related or random using developer-forum patterns
Sort pooled topics by view_count descending
Split at median view_count into high-engagement and low-engagement halves
Compare need fraction in high vs low engagement halves
Compute Cliff's delta and Mann-Whitney U test on view_count distributions
